habitat: Rugged open country, cliffs, rocky escarpments and steep river gorges, alpine meadows and barren high plateaus; also monasteries and village buildings; 1500–5200 m
description: More pale-headed than Rock Pigeon, but the key distinguishing trait is a broad white stripe across its dark tail which is visible both in flight and when perched; the wild-type Rock Pigeon has a darktipped gray tail …
